Figure 1: Visas Granted to Citizens of India, China, South Korea, Japan, and the Philippines
Author's calculations using data from US Department of State (2025).

F-1 visas apply to students, H-1B visas for high-skill workers, J-1 for exchange researchers/medical residents, and H-2A/B visas for agricultural and non-agricultural work, respectively. Data spans Fiscal Years 1997 to 2024.
Blue line with filled circles — F-1 (student)
Red line with filled circles — H-1B (high-skill worker)
Cyan/teal line with filled circles — J-1 (exchange/researchers and med residents)
Green line with filled circles — H-2A (agricultural worker)
Purple line with filled circles — H-2B (temp non-agri)
